mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal damage; tobramycin is aminoglycoside with concentration-dependent nephrotoxicity and levofloxacin can impair renal function, increasing tobramycin accumulation and toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function closely (serum creatinine, BUN, urinalysis); ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative fluoroquinolone or aminoglycoside if possible; dosage adjustment may be necessary based on renal clearance.
